differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the cards, making the Recurly logo card fill the upper-left area of the frame.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away, leaving large empty white spaces around the cards.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera zoom or distance to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: Stronger vignetting is visible, with the corners of the frame being significantly darker than the center.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is uniform across the frame, lacking the corner falloff.
differences.fix: Add a vignette post-process or adjust the physical camera light falloff.

differences.a_observable: The Live Now button casts a soft, diffused shadow on the surface below as it rises.
differences.b_observable: The shadow under the Live Now button is extremely faint and lacks realistic diffusion.
differences.fix: Increase the shadow softness and contact shadow intensity for the rising button.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera distance and focal length to match the closer, more dynamic framing of the reference video.

differences.a_observable: Soft, diffused contact shadows under the cards.
differences.b_observable: Harsh, dark, sharp-edged shadows under the cards.
differences.fix: Increase shadow softness and add ambient occlusion.

differences.a_observable: Tilted camera perspective with diagonal grid lines.
differences.b_observable: Flatter camera perspective with more orthogonal grid lines.
differences.fix: Adjust camera rotation and perspective to match the reference.

differences.a_observable: Warm golden-yellow hue on the Recurly card.
differences.b_observable: Cooler, slightly desaturated yellow hue on the Recurly card.
differences.fix: Adjust yellow material color to be warmer and more saturated.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Soften the shadows under the cards and adjust the camera angle to match the dynamic perspective of the reference.
